name: luna
description: An AI marketing team that thinks before it creates. Observes attention, kills weak ideas, engineers hooks, and learns from results.

interface.longDescription: Luna observes attention instead of generating content. She researches the audience before ideating, kills ideas that cannot earn attention, engineers hooks, and records what worked so the next month is better than this one.
